momentum.description: Trend-following entries (ORB, breakout, MA cross, HMM trend regime)

mean_reversion.description: Fade entries against extended moves (VWAP fade, RSI2, BB reversion)

volatility_premium.description: Short-vol structures: credit spreads, iron condors, cash-secured puts

volatility_expansion.description: Long-vol / long-premium: straddles, strangles, directional long calls or puts around expected move breaches

catalyst_reactive.description: One-shot signals triggered by a discrete, timestamped disclosure or announcement that already occurred (EDGAR 8-K, earnings beat, or a same-event Form 4 cluster); excludes rolling or longitudinal positioning aggregates

catalyst_scheduled.description: Signals gating around known future events (FOMC, earnings, ex-dividend and rebalance blackouts)

orderflow_microstructure.description: Signals derived from bid/ask book, NBBO, OFI/VPIN, or dark-pool prints

positioning_dealer.description: Dealer-positioning inference: GEX, max pain, 0DTE pin and gamma regime

alt_data_smart_money.description: Rolling or longitudinal non-price aggregates implying informed positioning (Congress-trade accumulation, 13F changes, and provider-derived positioning); excludes signals triggered directly by an individual EDGAR/SEC filing or same-event Form 4 cluster

sentiment_retail.description: Retail-sentiment velocity from WSB, StockTwits, and volume-weighted X/Twitter observations

regime_macro.description: Cross-asset regime state: HMM regime, PCA breadth, RV/IV, VIX term structure, and market force

nlp_catalyst.description: NLP-derived catalyst confidence from filing sentiment and earnings-transcript scoring

notes: Taxonomy determines the family-level trial denominator used by Deflated Sharpe.
No family may be used for registration or re-evaluation until reviewed_by_human is true.
Changing a registered signal family creates a new hypothesis and a new append-only trial-ledger row.
